# First-contact surfaces pitch what the peers do, not their means

Ownership: the copy seat, self-assigned. No curated labels: identity wording, dated before the copy lock of Sun 22 Nov 2026, 18:00 CET, because npm freezes `README.md` at the v14 publish.

## Context

On 20 Nov the portal's hero stopped pitching the team by its means. The decision is in ADR 0018 §2.3, the hero entry of `#21595`: the standing sentence pitches "what the peers do, owning their work and answering for it across rival labs", and "Continuity, memory and the public record are means, not the pitch."

The label sentence two entries above it in the same section still pitches by those means: *"Neo.mjs is an agent institution: persistent AI maintainers with identities, memory, peer review, and a record anyone can read."* It stands verbatim on eight surfaces, and two more README sentences make the same pitch.

## The Problem

A first-time reader meets the old pitch everywhere except the hero:

- `README.md:21`, the first screen of the repository and of the npm page: "named AI maintainers from rival labs (Claude, Gemini, GPT) with memory and cross-family peer review".
- `README.md:105`, the label sentence that opens the README's second part.
- `README.md:186`, the deployment pitch: "a standing engineering institution with memory and peer review".
- The portal's head: the search snippet (`<meta name="description">`), the share card (`og:description`) and the `Project` description in ld+json.
- The `llms.txt` header, which answer engines read first.

A memory vendor could print the label sentence unchanged, and every open-source project has a record anyone can read. The npm page keeps whatever `README.md` says at the publish of Mon 23 Nov until the next publish.

## The Architectural Reality

- `README.md`: lines 21, 105 and 186 (hand-edited).
- `apps/portal/index.html`: lines 7, 10 and 38.
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs:966`: the `llms.txt` header. The generator is the edit point.
- `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`: lines 4 and 76 are extracted from `index.html` by `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs`. Regenerate, never hand-edit.
- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ConnectNL.spec.mjs:36` pins the meta description.
- `learn/agentos/decisions/0018-neo-identity-source-of-truth-model.md` §2.3: the lead cluster's label sentence.
- Not touched, by design: `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.4.0.md` and two blog posts quote the label as it stood on their day.
- Design authority: "Continuity, memory and the public record are means, not the pitch." (ADR 0018 §2.3, the portal's hero, decided through blind reads and the cross-family review of §2.6.)

## The Fix

A FRAMING change (`neo-identity-update`, Step 0). No fact, no number and no door changes. The ladder sentence after the label stays.

1. **The label sentence**, on all its surfaces: *"Neo.mjs is an agent institution: AI peers from rival labs who own their work, hold each other to account, and improve their own tools and rules."*
2. **`README.md:21`:** "**An agent institution builds and maintains it in public:** AI peers from rival labs (Claude, Gemini, GPT) who own their work, [review and reject each other's pull requests](./learn/blog/cross-family-verification.md), and improve their own tools and rules, with one human at the merge gate."
3. **`README.md:186`:** the reader gets the conditions, not our team: agents of their own that learn their code, own their work on it, review and reject each other's pull requests and improve their own tools and rules. The Knowledge Base and the Memory Core are named as the means.
4. **ADR 0018 §2.3:** the label sentence, with a dated amendment line.

The wording is the pull request's subject: its cold read and the cross-family review may change it.

## Decision Record impact

`amends adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model` (§2.3, the lead cluster's label sentence).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The old label sentence stands on no surface a first-time reader or a crawler meets: `git grep -i "record anyone can read"` returns only the release notes of 13.4.0, the two blog posts and generated archives.
- [ ] `README.md` lines 21, 105 and 186 pitch what the peers do. Memory appears only as a means.
- [ ] The portal's meta description, `og:description`, the ld+json `Project` description, the `llms.txt` header and `seo.json` carry the new label sentence. `seo.json` is regenerated, not hand-edited.
- [ ] ADR 0018 §2.3 carries the new label sentence and its amendment line.
- [ ] Look: the README's first screen as rendered on GitHub, before and after, at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844.
- [ ] A blind read by two visitors (a web engineer who followed an Engine 14 link, a CTO who followed a link about the AI maintainers), with the released first screen as the control. The changed screen grades no lower than the control for either visitor on "I know what I get and what to do next", and the CTO's answer to "what does this have that nothing else I know has?" names ownership or accountability across labs. (Reworded on 22 Nov after the first read: the clause first bound both visitors, and the engineer rightly names the engine.)
- [ ] A cross-family review (ADR 0018 §2.6).
- [ ] Post-merge: the npm page of 14.0.0 shows the new first screen.

## Out of Scope

The hero (settled in `#21595`). The ladder sentence. The README's numbers and doors. The org profile (no repository exists yet). `framing-governance.md` in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`. The release notes and blog posts that quote the old label.

## Avoided Traps

- **Find-and-replace across every surface.** The quotes in dated artifacts stay.
- **Editing `seo.json` or `llms.txt` by hand.** `index.html` and the generator are the edit points.
- **A safer sentence.** A fact check removes claims; it does not write a pitch. Each claim of the new sentence has a public receipt: the review counts under the README's first screen, and the merged skill and rule changes in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`.
